task_title: B1: Add generated equipment instance registry

plan_review.notes: 1. Generation inputs: instance fields (baseId/itemLevel/rarity/enhancementLevel/resolvedEffects) ARE the versioned inputs — no separate type needed; added doc comment. 2. Serialization boundary: added snapshotRegistry/hydrateRegistry APIs to establish boundary without full carryover. 3. Runtime validation: added validateInstanceV1() before registration (rarity/enhancement/stat keys/effect budget/effect uniqueness). 4. Async write path: registerInstance is async (validates fingerprint cryptographically); generation/hydration happens off frame loop so async is fine. 5. FrozenEquipmentFieldsV1 versioning: weapon snapshot adds optional field in weapon-snapshot slice (V1 compatible); doc comment added. 6. Stricter guards: regex for instanceId (^gei:v1:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+:\d+$), fingerprint (^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$), non-negative integer ordinal check. 7. Added tests for: structural validation rejection, per-world isolation, canonicalization stability, malformed IDs, mutation isolation.
